prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review and approve your new desktop pet's official credentials before activation."]
1: ["Test Pet Voice & Sounds", "Click the sound buttons to hear how your desktop pet will respond when clicked or summoned.", "Launch to Desktop", "Play Happy Meow"]
2: ["Sign In to Connect Your Pet", "Sign in to save your adoption progress or restore pets previously saved to another account.", "Looking for a previously adopted pet?"]
3: []
4: ["Sign In to Save or Recover Your Pet", "Use your primary account email to ensure your pet progress and accessories remain restored and saved across devices."]
5: ["Ready for Desktop Launch", "Review the desktop shortcuts below to control, hide, or talk with your pet anytime."]
6: ["Desktop Companion Verified"]
7: ["Note: Your pet app initializes in the system tray / taskbar area. Check your taskbar if window is minimized."]
8: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Engine", "Setting up graphics renderers and background system hooks. Audio chime will play when complete.", "Engine Startup Tone"]
9: ["Feel free to switch windows. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet is active."]
